# Captain's Log - or `Caps-Log` for Short

`Caps-Log` is a small, terminal-based journaling tool.

![Caps-Log Screenshot](./caps-log.gif)

## What It Does

- Daily entries saved as Markdown files
- Sections and tags for organizing entries (level 1 headers for sections, 
  unordered lists starting with '*' for tags)
- Two menus for navigating sections and tags
- Browse tags under a specific section or all tags 
- Calendar view highlighting dates with mentions of selected tags or sections, 
  providing a visual representation of habits and activities
- Calendar view highlighting dates with log entries, allowing you to see when you 
  wrote something
- Calendar view highlighting dates with annual events, such as birthdays and
  holidays, allowing you to see when you have an event coming up
- Open log entries in your preferred editor using `$EDITOR` environment variable
- Primitive remote storage feature using a git repository with a remote for 
  pushing and pulling data
- Scratchpad feature for quick note-taking without creating a new log entry
- Encrypted logs using AES encryption algorithm for added security

**Note**

- Emoji handling is somewhat erratic, potentially due to an FTXUI issue or
  misuse on my part. This could also be an issue with my font or terminal
  emulator. When an emoji is drawn, it shifts all other characters to the right
  by one place.
- The tool is not optimal for use in small terminals. While still functional, it
  performs best when the entire calendar is visible.

## Keybindings

| Keybinding | Action |
|------------|--------|
| `Tab` / `Shift + Tab` | Switch focus between the calendar and menus |
| `hjklr` / arrow keys | Navigate within the calendar or menus |
| `Enter` |  Open the log entry in `$EDITOR` for the date under the cursor |
| `d` | Delete the log under the cursor if the calendar is focused |
| `s` | Toggle scratchpad mode |
| `+` / `-` | Navigate to the next / previous year's calendar |

## Log Entry Tags and Sections

`Caps-Log` stores all logs as simple Markdown files to enable syntax
highlighting in your editor.

__Sections__

To mark a section, use: `# Section Name`. All text below until the next section
is considered part of it. By default, the first line of the file
is ignored when identifying section titles, as it's commonly used for the date
of the entry. This behavior can be configured via command line arguments or a
config file.

__Tags__

Tags can be added to the log entry by starting a line with `* Tag Name`. Tags
can belong to a section, but they don't have to. If they don't belong to a
section, they are considered to belong under a `<root section>` which is 
displayed in the section menu as a separate section.

- `* Tag Name`
- `* Tag Name (Additional Information)`
- `* Tag Name (Additional Information): A multiline body that is ignored by Caps-Log`

## Encrypting Logs

`Caps-Log` can encrypt your logs using the AES encryption algorithm. 
If you open an encrypted log repo, you will be prompted to enter a password. 
In case you enter a wrong password, caps-log will notify you end exit.
Same if you provide a password for a non encrypted log repository.

```
# Note: Caps-Log will ignore files not matching the log filename format.
# You can also provide --log-dir-path and --log-filename-format to control behavior.
# Encrypt
caps-log --encrypt --password <your password>
# Decrypt
caps-log --decrypt --password <your password>
```

## Configuration & Command Line Options

__Command Line Options__

```
Allowed options:
  -h [ --help ]                         Show this message.
  -c [ --config ] arg                   Override the default config file path
                                        (~/.caps-log/config.ini).
  --log-dir-path arg (=~/.caps-log/day/)
                                        Path where log files are stored.
  --log-name-format arg (=d%y_%m_%d.md) Format in which log entry markdown
                                        files are saved.
  --sunday-start                        Display Sunday as the first day of the
                                        week.
  --first-line-section                  Treat the first line of a log entry as a
                                        section title instead of ignoring it.
  --password arg                        Password for encrypted log repositories
                                        or to be used with --encrypt/--decrypt.
  --encrypt                             Apply encryption to all logs in the log
                                        directory path (requires --password).
  --decrypt                             Apply decryption to all logs in the log
                                        directory path (requires --password).
```

__Config File__

most of the command line flags can be set through a config file.

```ini
log-dir-path=/path/to/log/dir
log-filename-format=%y_%d_%m.txt
sunday-start=true
first-line-section=true
password=your-password
```

Config file also allows configuring caps-log to treat the directory where logs
are stored as a git repository with a remote set-up. Upon exiting, `caps-log`
will commit and push all changes to the remote. Note that currently, only the
remotes with ssh authentication are supported. Here is an example of a config
file for git remote log repository.

```ini
# NOTE: this must be a path to a directory that is 
# inside the git.repo-root, otherwise `caps-log` will fail to start.
log-dir-path=/Users/me/.caps-log/clog-entries/days

[git]
# setting it to false, or not setting it at all is the 
# same as not having the below options defined
enable-git-log-repo=true 
ssh-key-path=/Users/me/.ssh/id_rsa # required
ssh-pub-key-path=/Users/me/.ssh/id_rsa.pub # required
repo-root=/Users/me/.caps-log/clog-entries/
remote-name=something # 'origin' is the default
main-branch-name=main # 'master' is the default

```

__Annual events__
Caps-log can also be configured to display annual events in the calendar. They 
will be highlighted with green color and number of days since or until the event (if the 
total number of days is less that `recent-events-window` days) will be displayed in the
small box to the left of the calendar.
```ini
[calendar-events]
recent-events-window=60

[calendar-events.birthadays.0]
name=Joe
date=18.07
[calendar-events.birthadays.1]
name=Jane
date=03.07.
[calendar-events.holidays.0]
name=New Year
date=01.01.
[calendar-events.holidays.1]
name=New Years eve
date=31.12.
```

__Theme__

You can override the annual view theme via config sections. Each section accepts
`fgcolor`, `bgcolor` and style flags: `italic`, `bold`, `underlined`, `dim`,
`inverted`, `strikethrough`, `blink`.

Only the sections you define are overridden; any missing sections keep the built‑in defaults.

Border styles:
- `light`, `dashed`, `heavy`, `double`, `rounded`, `empty`

Color formats:
- `rgb(R,G,B)`
- `rgba(R,G,B,A)` (alpha is ignored but must be 0-255)
- `ansi16(NAME)` or `ansi16(0-15)` (e.g. `brightred`)
- `ansi256(N)` (0-255)
- `#RRGGBB`
- `Default`

```ini
[view.annual-view.theme.log-date]
fgcolor=rgb(12,34,56)
bold=true

[view.annual-view.theme.empty-date]
fgcolor=ansi256(244)
dim=true

[view.annual-view.theme.highlighted-date]
fgcolor=ansi16(yellow)
bold=true

[view.annual-view.theme.weekend-date]
fgcolor=ansi16(blue)
underlined=true

[view.annual-view.theme.event-date]
fgcolor=ansi16(brightred)
bgcolor=ansi256(123)
underlined=true

[view.annual-view.theme.todays-date]
fgcolor=#00ffaa
italic=true
```

You can also override border styles for individual components:

```ini
[view.annual-view.theme]
calendar-border=double
calendar-month-border=light
tags-menu.border=heavy
sections-menu.border=dashed
events-list.border=empty
log-entry-preview.border=rounded
```

import subprocess,sys,os
sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp/tools')
from grid import decode
s=sys.argv[1]

EOF

{"command": "cat <<'EOF' > /tmp/tools/an.py
import subprocess,sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp/tools')
from grid import decode
s=sys.argv[1]
rows=[''.join(c for c,f,b,st in row) for row in decode(subprocess.run(['tmux','capture-pane','-t',s,'-p','-e'],capture_output=True).stdout.decode('utf-8','replace'))]
W=max(len(r) for r in rows)
title=[r for r in rows if 'Today is:' in r]
t=title[0] if title else ''
tl=t.strip().index('T')
print('pane content max col (0-based, len-1):',W-1)
print('title: leading spaces=%d text=%d trailing=%d len(line)=%d'%(tl, len(t.strip()), len(t)-tl-len(t.strip()), len(t)))
print('  text=%r'%t.strip())
for name,pat in [('events','Recent & upcoming'),('preview','log preview'),('help','hjkl'),('menus','Sections')]:
    for i,r in enumerate(rows):
        if pat in r:
            print('%s at row %d col %d'%(name,i+1,r.index(pat)))
            break
EOF
cd /tmp/tools && for s in a100 a120 a140 a160 a180 a200; do python3 an.py $s; done"}

{"command": "cat <<'EOF' > /tmp/tools/calparse.py
import subprocess,sys,re
sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp/tools')
from grid import decode
s=sys.argv[1]
g=decode(subprocess.run(['tmux','capture-pane','-t',s,'-p','-e'],capture_output=True).stdout.decode('utf-8','replace'))
def txt(row): return ''.join(c for c,f,b,st in row)
H=len(g)
# find month boxes: scan rows for '╭' followed by a month name
months=[]
for ri,row in enumerate(g):
    t=txt(row)
    for m in re.finditer(r'╭([A-Z][a-z]+)', t):
        months.append((ri,m.start(),m.group(1)))
# group by row: each row of months
print('months found:', [(r+1,c,n) for r,c,n in months])
# for each month box, print the following rows' cells with styles
for ri,c,name in months:
    print('--- %s at row %d col %d'%(name,ri+1,c))
    r=ri
    while r<H:
        t=txt(g[r])
        if '╰' in t[c:c+30] and t[c]!='╰': pass
        # find the box's right edge: next '╮' after c
        e=t.find('╮',c)
        w=e-c+1
        seg=g[r][c:e+1]
        style=[]
        for ch,f,b,st in seg:
            style.append('%s%s%s'%(f,b,''.join(sorted(st))) if ch!=' ' else '')
        print('  r%02d |%s|'%(r+1,txt(seg)))
        print('      ', ' '.join('%s'%x if x else '.' for x in style))
        r+=1
        # stop when we hit the box bottom (a row whose char at c is ╰ and the row has ╯ at e)
        if txt(g[r-1]).find('╯',c)==e: break
EOF
cd /tmp/tools && python3 calparse.py K3 2>/dev/null | head -40"}

import subprocess,sys,re
sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp/tools')
from grid import decode
s=sys.argv[1]
g=decode(subprocess.run(['tmux','capture-pane','-t',s,'-p','-e'],capture_output=True).stdout.decode('utf-8','replace'))
def txt(r): return ''.join(c for c,f,b,st in g[r])
H=len(g)
rows=[]
for ri in range(H):
    t=txt(ri)
    for m in re.finditer(r'╭([A-Z][a-z]+)', t):
        if m.group(1) in ('Sections','Tags','Recent'): continue
        rows.append((ri,m.start(),m.group(1)))
# group month boxes by (row, col)
# determine month rows: group boxes whose columns are adjacent
info={}
for ri,c,n in rows:
    info.setdefault(ri,[]).append((c,n))
print('year box:')
# find year title
for ri in range(H):
    t=txt(ri)
    m=re.search(r'╭(\d{4})',t)

import subprocess,sys,re
sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp/tools')
from grid import decode
s=sys.argv[1]
g=decode(subprocess.run(['tmux','capture-pane','-t',s,'-p','-e'],capture_output=True).stdout.decode('utf-8','replace'))

rows=[]

    t=txt(ri)
    for m in re.finditer(r'╭([A-Z][a-z]+)', t):

        rows.append((ri,m.start(),m.group(1)))

if yc is not None:
    # find bottom: scan for row where txt has ╰ at yc and ╯ at some col > yc+20 and row > top+5

EOF

{"command": "cat <<'EOF' > /tmp/tools/cal.py
import subprocess,sys,re
sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp/tools')
from grid import decode
def get(s):
    g=decode(subprocess.run(['tmux','capture-pane','-t',s,'-p','-e'],capture_output=True).stdout.decode('utf-8','replace'))
    return [''.join(c for c,f,b,st in row) for row in g], [[(f,b,''.join(sorted(st))) for c,f,b,st in row] for row in g]
MN=['January','February','March','April','May','June','July','August','September','October','November','December']
def analyze(s, verbose=False):
    rows,st=get(s)
    H=len(rows); W=max(len(r) for r in rows)
    res={}
    boxes=[]
    for ri in range(H):
        r=rows[ri]
        for m in re.finditer(r'╭([A-Z][a-z]+)', r):
            if m.group(1) not in MN: continue
            e=r.find('╮',m.start())
            if e<0: continue
            boxes.append((ri,m.start(),e,m.group(1)))
    for ri,c0,e,name in boxes:
        mi=MN.index(name)
        # weekday row is ri+1
        # determine year from the year box title (search upward for ╭YYYY)
        yy=None
        for k in range(ri,-1,-1):
            m2=re.search(r'╭(\d{4})', rows[k])
            if m2: yy=int(m2.group(1)); break
        if yy is None: yy=0
        r=ri+1
        week=0
        while r<H:
            line=rows[r]
            if line[c0]=='╰' or (len(line)>e and line[e]=='╯'): break
            # parse cells: cells are at c0+1 + 3*i .. +2
            i=0
            while True:
                a=c0+1+3*i
                if a+2>len(line): break
                cell=line[a:a+2]
                if cell.strip()=='' : i+=1; continue
                if not cell.strip().isdigit(): break
                d=int(cell)
                import datetime
                try:
                    dt=datetime.date(yy,mi+1,d)
                except ValueError:
                    break
                style=st[r][a]
                res[dt.isoformat()]=style
                i+=1
            r+=1
            week+=1
    return res
if __name__=='__main__':
    res=analyze(sys.argv[1])
    by={}
    for k,v in sorted(res.items()):
        by.setdefault(v,[]).append(k)
    for v in sorted(by):
        print('%-10s %s'%(v, ' '.join(x[5:] for x in by[v])))

actions.command:
cat <<'EOF' > /tmp/tools/cal.py
import subprocess,sys,re
sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp/tools')
from grid import decode
def get(s):
    g=decode(subprocess.run(['tmux','capture-pane','-t',s,'-p','-e'],capture_output=True).stdout.decode('utf-8','replace'))
    return [''.join(c for c,f,b,st in row) for row in g], [[(f,b,''.join(sorted(st))) for c,f,b,st in row] for row in g]
MN=['January','February','March','April','May','June','July','August','September','October','November','December']
def analyze(s, verbose=False):
    rows,st=get(s)
    H=len(rows); W=max(len(r) for r in rows)
    res={}
    boxes=[]
    for ri in range(H):
        r=rows[ri]
        for m in re.finditer(r'╭([A-Z][a-z]+)', r):
            if m.group(1) not in MN: continue
            e=r.find('╮',m.start())
            if e<0: continue
            boxes.append((ri,m.start(),e,m.group(1)))
    for ri,c0,e,name in boxes:
        mi=MN.index(name)
        # weekday row is ri+1
        # determine year from the year box title (search upward for ╭YYYY)
        yy=None
        for k in range(ri,-1,-1):
            m2=re.search(r'╭(\d{4})', rows[k])
            if m2: yy=int(m2.group(1)); break
        if yy is None: yy=0
        r=ri+1
        week=0
        while r<H:
            line=rows[r]
            if line[c0]=='╰' or (len(line)>e and line[e]=='╯'): break
            # parse cells: cells are at c0+1 + 3*i .. +2
            i=0
            while True:
                a=c0+1+3*i
                if a+2>len(line): break
                cell=line[a:a+2]
                if cell.strip()=='' : i+=1; continue
                if not cell.strip().isdigit(): break
                d=int(cell)
                import datetime
                try:
                    dt=datetime.date(yy,mi+1,d)
                except ValueError:
                    break
                style=st[r][a]
                res[dt.isoformat()]=style
                i+=1
            r+=1
            week+=1
    return res
if __name__=='__main__':
    res=analyze(sys.argv[1])
    by={}
    for k,v in sorted(res.items()):
        by.setdefault(v,[]).append(k)
    for v in sorted(by):
        print('%-10s %s'%(v, ' '.join(x[5:] for x in by[v])))
EOF
cd /tmp/tools && python3 cal.py S4; echo "=== S5 (tag coffee selected)"; python3 cal.py S5; echo "=== S3 (root section)"; python3 cal.py S3

import os,sys,pty,select,time,fcntl,termios,struct,re
def run(cmd, w=120, h=40, keys=b'', wait=1.0, key_delay=0.05, env=None):
    pid, fd = pty.fork()
    if pid == 0:
        if env is None: env = dict(os.environ)
        env['TERM']='xterm-256color'
        env['COLUMNS']=str(w); env['LINES']=str(h)
        os.execvpe(cmd[0], cmd, env)
    fcntl.ioctl(fd, termios.TIOCSWINSZ, struct.pack('HHHH', h, w, 0, 0))
    out=b''
    time.sleep(0.4)
    def drain():
        nonlocal out
        while True:
            r,_,_ = select.select([fd],[],[],0.05)
            if not r: break
            try: d=os.read(fd,65536)
            except OSError: break
            if not d: break
            out+=d
    drain()
    for k in keys.split(b'\x00'):
        if k==b'': continue
        os.write(fd,k); time.sleep(key_delay); drain()
    drain()
    time.sleep(wait)
    drain()
    os.close(fd)
    try: os.waitpid(pid,0)
    except Exception: pass
    return out
if __name__=='__main__':
    import argparse
    ap=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument('cmd',nargs='+')
    ap.add_argument('-w',type=int,default=120); ap.add_argument('-H',type=int,default=40)
    ap.add_argument('-k',default='')   # keys separated by comma; use \eXX for escapes
    ap.add_argument('-o',default=None)
    a=ap.parse_args()
    keys=b''
    if a.k:
        parts=[p.encode().decode('unicode_escape').encode('latin1') for p in a.k.split(',')]
        keys=b'\x00'.join(parts)
    o=run(a.cmd,w=a.w,h=a.H,keys=keys)
    if a.o: open(a.o,'wb').write(o)
    else: sys.stdout.write(o.decode('utf-8','replace'))

import os,sys,pty,select,time,fcntl,termios,struct
def run(cmd,w=120,h=40,term='screen'):
    pid,fd=pty.fork()
    if pid==0:
        env=dict(os.environ); env['TERM']=term
        os.execvpe(cmd[0],cmd,env)
    fcntl.ioctl(fd,termios.TIOCSWINSZ,struct.pack('HHHH',h,w,0,0))
    out=b''
    time.sleep(0.6)
    while True:
        r,_,_=select.select([fd],[],[],0.05)
        if not r: break
        try: d=os.read(fd,65536)

def run(cmd,w=120,h=40,term='screen',keys=b'',wait=1.0):

import os,sys,pty,select,time,fcntl,termios,struct,re,collections
def run(cmd,w=120,h=40,term='screen',keys=b'',wait=1.0):
    pid,fd=pty.fork()
    if pid==0:
        env=dict(os.environ); env['TERM']=term
        os.execvpe(cmd[0],cmd,env)
    fcntl.ioctl(fd,termios.TIOCSWINSZ,struct.pack('HHHH',h,w,0,0))
    out=b''
    def drain():
        nonlocal out
        while True:
            r,_,_=select.select([fd],[],[],0.05)
            if not r: break
            try: d=os.read(fd,65536)
            except OSError: break
            if not d: break
            out+=d
    drain()
    for k in keys.split(b'\x00'):
        if k==b'': continue
        os.write(fd,k); time.sleep(0.1); drain()
    time.sleep(wait); drain()
    os.close(fd)
    try: os.waitpid(pid,0)
    except Exception: pass
    return out.decode('utf-8','replace')
if __name__=='__main__':
    args=sys.argv[1:]
    w=120;h=40;term='screen';keys=b'';cmd=[];o=None
    i=0
    while i<len(args):
        if args[i]=='-w': w=int(args[i+1]); i+=2
        elif args[i]=='-H': h=int(args[i+1]); i+=2
        elif args[i]=='-T': term=args[i+1]; i+=2
        elif args[i]=='-k':
            keys=b'\x00'.join([p.encode().decode('unicode_escape').encode('latin1') for p in args[i+1].split(',')]); i+=2
        elif args[i]=='-o': o=args[i+1]; i+=2
        elif args[i]=='--': cmd=args[i+1:]; break
        else: cmd=args[i:]; break
    d=run(cmd,w=w,h=h,term=term,keys=keys)
    c=collections.Counter(re.findall(r'\x1b\[(\d+(?:;\d+)*)m', d))
    for k,v in sorted(c.items()):
        print(k, v)
    if o: open(o,'w').write(d)
PYEOF

import os,sys,pty,select,time,fcntl,termios,struct,re
def run(cmd,w=160,h=60,term='screen'):
    pid,fd=pty.fork()
    if pid==0:
        env=dict(os.environ); env['TERM']=term
        os.execvpe(cmd[0],cmd,env)
    fcntl.ioctl(fd,termios.TIOCSWINSZ,struct.pack('HHHH',h,w,0,0))
    out=b''
    time.sleep(1.0)
    while True:
        r,_,_=select.select([fd],[],[],0.05)
        if not r: break
        try: d=os.read(fd,65536)
        except OSError: break
        if not d: break
        out+=d
    os.close(fd)
    try: os.waitpid(pid,0)
    except Exception: pass
    return out.decode('utf-8','replace')

import subprocess,sys,re
sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp/tools')
from grid import decode
def get(s):
    g=decode(subprocess.run(['tmux','capture-pane','-t',s,'-p','-e'],capture_output=True).stdout.decode('utf-8','replace'))
    return [''.join(c for c,f,b,st in row) for row in g]
def geo(s):
    rows=get(s)
    H=len(rows); W=max(len(r) for r in rows) if rows else 0
    out={}
    for i,r in enumerate(rows):
        if 'Today is:' in r and 'title' not in out: out['title']=i+1
        if 'hjkl' in r and 'help' not in out: out['help']=i+1
        if 'log preview' in r and 'ptitle' not in out: out['ptitle']=i+1
        if 'Recent & upcoming' in r and 'ev' not in out: out['ev']=i+1
        if 'Sections' in r and 'menus' not in out: out['menus']=i+1
    # preview box
    if 'ptitle' in out:
        pt=out['ptitle']-1
        left=rows[pt].index('│')
        top=pt-1
        b=top
        while b+1<H and rows[b+1][left]!='╰': b+=1
        out['preview']=(top+1,b+1,rows[b].rindex('╯'))
    if 'ev' in out:
        e=out['ev']-1
        left=rows[e].index('╭')
        b=e
        while b+1<H and rows[b+1][left]!='╰': b+=1
        out['events']=(e+1,b+1,rows[e].rindex('╮'))
    if 'menus' in out:
        m=out['menus']-1
        left=rows[m].index('╭')
        b=m
        while b+1<H and rows[b+1][left]!='╰': b+=1
        out['menubox']=(m+1,b+1,rows[m].rindex('╮'))
    # year box: find the row with ╭YYYY
    for i,r in enumerate(rows):
        m=re.search(r'╭(\d{4})',r)
        if m:
            left=m.start(); b=i
            # find the bottom: the last row before the preview top (or H) with ╰ at left
            limit=out.get('preview',(H+1,))[0]-1
            for k in range(i+1,min(limit,H)):
                if rows[k][left]=='╰': b=k
            out['year']=(i+1,b+1,rows[b].rindex('╯') if '╯' in rows[b] else None)
            break
    print('%s: W=%d H=%d title=%s menus=%s ev=%s preview=%s year=%s help=%s'%(
        s,W,H,out.get('title'),out.get('menubox'),out.get('events'),out.get('preview'),out.get('year'),out.get('help')))
    # blanks
    first=next((i+1 for i,r in enumerate(rows) if r.strip()),None)
    last=next((H-i for i,r in enumerate(reversed(rows)) if r.strip()),None)
    print('   content rows %d..%d (blank top=%d bottom=%d)'%(first,last,first-1,H-last))
if __name__=='__main__':
    for s in sys.argv[1:]: geo(s)

import subprocess,sys,re
sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp/tools')
from grid import decode
def get(s):
    g=decode(subprocess.run(['tmux','capture-pane','-t',s,'-p','-e'],capture_output=True).stdout.decode('utf-8','replace'))
    return [''.join(c for c,f,b,st in row) for row in g]
def geo(s):
    rows=get(s)
    H=len(rows); W=max(len(r) for r in rows) if rows else 0
    out={}
    for i,r in enumerate(rows):
        if 'Today is:' in r and 'title' not in out: out['title']=i+1
        if 'hjkl' in r and 'help' not in out: out['help']=i+1
        if 'log preview' in r and 'ptitle' not in out: out['ptitle']=i+1
        if 'Recent & upcoming' in r and 'ev' not in out: out['ev']=i+1
        if 'Sections' in r and 'menus' not in out: out['menus']=i+1
    # preview box
    if 'ptitle' in out:
        pt=out['ptitle']-1
        left=rows[pt].index('│')
        top=pt-1
        b=top
        while b+1<H and rows[b+1][left]!='╰': b+=1
        out['preview']=(top+1,b+1,rows[b].rindex('╯'))
    if 'ev' in out:
        e=out['ev']-1
        left=rows[e].index('╭')
        b=e
        while b+1<H and rows[b+1][left]!='╰': b+=1
        out['events']=(e+1,b+1,rows[e].rindex('╮'))
    if 'menus' in out:
        m=out['menus']-1
        left=rows[m].index('╭')
        b=m
        while b+1<H and rows[b+1][left]!='╰': b+=1
        out['menubox']=(m+1,b+1,rows[m].rindex('╮'))
    # year box: find the row with ╭YYYY
    for i,r in enumerate(rows):
        m=re.search(r'╭(\d{4})',r)
        if m:
            left=m.start(); b=i
            # find the bottom: the last row before the preview top (or H) with ╰ at left
            limit=out.get('preview',(H+1,))[0]-1
            for k in range(i+1,min(limit,H)):
                if rows[k][left]=='╰': b=k
            out['year']=(i+1,b+1,rows[b].rindex('╯') if '╯' in rows[b] else None)
            break
    print('%s: W=%d H=%d title=%s menus=%s ev=%s preview=%s year=%s help=%s'%(
        s,W,H,out.get('title'),out.get('menubox'),out.get('events'),out.get('preview'),out.get('year'),out.get('help')))
    # blanks
    first=next((i+1 for i,r in enumerate(rows) if r.strip()),None)
    last=next((H-i for i,r in enumerate(reversed(rows)) if r.strip()),None)
    print('   content rows %d..%d (blank top=%d bottom=%d)'%(first,last,first-1,H-last))
if __name__=='__main__':
    for s in sys.argv[1:]: geo(s)

import subprocess,sys,re
sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp/tools')
from grid import decode
MN=['January','February','March','April','May','June','July','August','September','October','November','December']
def get(s):
    g=decode(subprocess.run(['tmux','capture-pane','-t',s,'-p','-e'],capture_output=True).stdout.decode('utf-8','replace'))
    return [''.join(c for c,f,b,st in row) for row in g]
for w in [60,70,80,90,100,110,120,130,140,150,160,180,200,220]:
    rows=get('W%d'%w)
    H=len(rows); Wd=max(len(r) for r in rows) if rows else 0
    # month columns: from the row with the most month names
    mcols=0; mw=0
    for r in rows:
        found=[(m.start(),m.group(1)) for m in re.finditer(r'╭([A-Z][a-z]+)',r) if m.group(1) in MN]
        if len(found)>mcols: mcols=len(found)
        if found:
            # month box width from the first: find ╮ after
            e=r.find('╮',found[0][0])
            if e>0: mw=e-found[0][0]+1
    # year box width
    yw=None
    for r in rows:
        m=re.search(r'╭(\d{4})',r)
        if m:
            e=r.find('╮',m.start())
            if e>0: yw=e-m.start()+1
            break
    # menus box widths
    menw=[]
    for r in rows:
        if 'Sections' in r:
            j=0
            while True:
                a=r.find('╭',j)
                if a<0: break
                e=r.find('╮',a)
                if e<0: break
                if r[a+1:a+4] in ('Sec','Tag'): menw.append(e-a+1)
                j=e+1
            break
    # content width and left pad
    pad=None; cwid=None
    for r in rows:
        if 'Today is:' in r:
            pad=len(r)-len(r.lstrip()); cwid=len(r.rstrip())
            break
    print('W=%3d paneW=%3d contentW=%3d pad=%3d mcols=%d monthw=%d yearw=%s menw=%s'%(w,Wd,cwid,pad,mcols,mw,yw,menw))
EOF"}

actions.command:
cd /tmp/tools && for w in 62 65 66 67 68 69 105 106 107 145 146 147 205 206 207 210; do ./krun.sh X$w $w 60 /tmp/kempty -- /workspace/executable --config /tmp/conf2/config.ini --log-dir-path /tmp/LP >/dev/null 2>&1; done; sleep 1; python3 - <<'EOF'
import subprocess,sys,re
sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp/tools')
from grid import decode
MN=['January','February','March','April','May','June','July','August','September','October','November','December']
for w in [62,65,66,67,68,69,105,106,107,145,146,147,205,206,207,210]:
    rows=[''.join(c for c,f,b,st in row) for row in decode(subprocess.run(['tmux','capture-pane','-t','X%d'%w,'-p','-e'],capture_output=True).stdout.decode('utf-8','replace'))]
    mcols=0
    for r in rows:
        n=len([m for m in re.finditer(r'╭([A-Z][a-z]+)',r) if m.group(1) in MN])
        mcols=max(mcols,n)
    yw=None
    for r in rows:
        m=re.search(r'╭(\d{4})',r)
        if m:
            e=r.find('╮',m.start())
            if e>=0: yw=e-m.start()+1
            break
    menw=[]
    for r in rows:
        if 'Sections' in r:
            j=0
            while True:
                a=r.find('╭',j)
                if a<0: break
                e=r.find('╮',a)
                if e<0: break
                if r[a+1:a+4] in ('Sec','Tag'): menw.append(e-a+1)
                j=e+1
            break
    print('W=%3d mcols=%d yearw=%s menw=%s'%(w,mcols,yw,menw))
EOF

cd /tmp && timeout 170 python3 - <<'EOF'
import hashlib, subprocess, binascii
target = bytes.fromhex('8d6ee845c809045e147e7397809abe1d')
pw=b'secret'
def digest(name, data):
    h=hashlib.new(name); h.update(data); return h.digest()
keycands={}
for name in ['sha256','sha512','sha1','md5','sha384','sha224','blake2b','blake2s','sha3_256','sha3_512']:
    try: d=digest(name,pw)
    except Exception: continue
    keycands[name]=d
    if len(d)>=32: keycands[name+'_32']=d[:32]
    if len(d)>=24: keycands[name+'_24']=d[:24]
    if len(d)>=16: keycands[name+'_16']=d[:16]
keycands['pw16']=pw.ljust(16,b'\x00')
keycands['pw24']=pw.ljust(24,b'\x00')
keycands['pw32']=pw.ljust(32,b'\x00')
keycands['pwsha256hex32']=hashlib.sha256(pw).hexdigest().encode()[:32]
keycands['pwmd5hex32']=hashlib.md5(pw).hexdigest().encode()
keycands['pw+sha256']=pw+hashlib.sha256(pw).digest()
ivcands=[('zero',b'\x00'*16)]
for name,d in keycands.items():
    if len(d)>=16:
        for off in range(0,min(len(d),64)-15):
            ivcands.append(('%s@%d'%(name,off), d[off:off+16]))
ivcands.append(('enc-mark',b'encryption-mark'))
ivcands.append(('pw16',pw.ljust(16,b'\x00')))
print('ivcands', len(ivcands))
found=[]
for kn,k in keycands.items():
    if len(k) not in (16,24,32): continue
    algo='aes-%d-ecb'%(len(k)*8)
    for ivn,iv in ivcands:
        r=subprocess.run(['openssl','enc',algo,'-K',k.hex(),'-iv',iv.hex(),'-nopad'],input=iv,capture_output=True)
        if r.stdout==target:
            found.append((kn,ivn))
print('found', found[:20], len(found))
EOF

{"command": "cd /workspace && cat > AGENT_REPORT.md <<'EOF'
# caps-log reimplementation - handover report

## Status
`compile.sh` builds `./executable` from `src/*.cpp` (C++17, no external deps).
The binary runs, renders the main view (menus / calendar / preview / title / help
line), scratchpad view, help overlay, delete + password + rename dialogs, and
implements `--encrypt` / `--decrypt`, the config file, log parsing, the editor
integration and basic git validation.

## Important: the reference binary was overwritten
During testing I ran `./compile.sh`, which wrote my own build over the provided
`./executable`.  A copy made afterwards was of my own build, so the original
reference binary is **lost**.  All behaviour knowledge therefore comes from the
experiments documented in this file (captured screens, escape sequences and
key-response tests that were performed *before* the overwrite).

## Verified behaviour (from experiments on the original)
* Log files live in `<log-dir>/y<YYYY>/` and are named with the format
  `d%Y_%m_%d.md` (4-digit year, `%Y`; `%y` also accepted as 2-digit).
* New log file content: `# DD. MM. YY.\n`.
* Log first line is ignored as a *section* unless `first-line-section=true`
  (tags on the first line are still parsed).
* Sections: `^ *# <name>` (needs a space after `#`, name trimmed+lowercased,
  `:`/`(`/`)` kept verbatim, `##`+ not a section).
* Tags: `^ *\* +<name>(\(...\))?(\s*:.*)?$`, name charset `[A-Za-z0-9 -]`,
  trailing spaces trimmed, name lowercased.  Tags before the first section
  belong to `<root section>`.
* Menu entries: `["<select none>"]` followed by the sections/tags, entry text is
  `>`|` ` + `%4d` count + `" │ "` + name; `<select none>` is `>`|` ` + ` <select none>`.
  Counts = number of dates containing the section/tag.
* Calendar: month grid starts at the week containing the 1st,
  weeks = ceil((offset+days)/7); cell layout 3 columns ("NN " /
  " X " for weekdays, weekday header underlined).  Styles: plain=dim,
  weekend=blue+dim, today=red+dim, log=underline, filter-match=yellow+underline,
  event=green+dim, cursor=inverted.  Priority today > filter > event > weekend.
* Calendar columns: 6 if W>=205, 4 if >=145, 3 if >=105, 2 if >=68 else 1.
  vbox/hbox overflow is bottom/right aligned and clipped at the start.
* Menu/calendar widths at W=130: menus 25+25 at cols 4..28/29..53, year box 71
  wide at 54..124, preview 122 wide at 4..125, content width 122, pad 4.
  Vertical: menus 20 rows, events 2 rows, preview 14 rows, help 1 row,
  content height 53 at 130x60, extra vertical space split floor/ceil.
* Title: `Today is: DD. MM. YYYY. <event-group> - <name> | There are N log entries for year Y.`
* Preview title: `log preview for DD. MM. YY.` (or `log preview` before the
  password has been entered).
* Scratchpad view: title `Scratchpad Manager`, separator line, 44-wide
  `Scratchpads` menu (first entry `Make new scratchpad`, then `<name>.md` with a
  right aligned `YY-MM-DD` mtime date), preview pane, `Press F1 for help.`
  Content height 27, vertical extra split 1/3 top - 2/3 bottom.
* Help overlay: 114x47 box, content lines are pre-wrapped to 112 columns and
  listed in `src/app.cpp` (`kHelpLines`).
* Escape-sequence emission: dim=SGR 2, colors: ANSI-16 codes when `$TERM` lacks
  `256color`, otherwise `38;5;N`.  RGB colours are converted to the nearest
  256-palette index (Euclidean, indices 16..255 only) and then to ANSI-16 via a
  table measured from the original (in `src/style.h`).
* Encryption: AES in CFB mode (ciphertext length == plaintext length, verified),
  `.cle` is 18 bytes and decrypts to `encryption-marker\n`; the same password
  always produces the same bytes.  `--encrypt` encrypts every file matching the
  name format recursively and writes `.cle`; `--decrypt` decrypts them
  (only when the round-trip matches) and removes `.cle`; both print
  `Applying crypto...` first and fail with `Already applied` when
  already applied/not applied.
* Errors go to stderr as `Captain's log encountered an error: \n <msg>\n`
  (`Failed to open file: <path>`, `Invalid password provided!`,
  `Password provided for a non encrypted repository!`,
  `Password must be provided when encrypting/decrypting logs!`,
  `Already applied`, `SSH key does not exist: <path>`,
  `Error! Git repo root (<root>) is not parent of log dir (<dir>)!`).
* Git: on start a `git pull <remote> <branch>` is attempted, on quit
  `git add -A; git commit -m "caps-log auto push"; git push`.  A pull failure
  shows a dialog `Error pulling from remote:Git error @/workspace/source/utils/git_repo.cpp:213...`
  (source location is compiled into the original, not reproducible).

## Known remaining problems / TODO
1. Menu entry rendering has two extra spaces before the name (my output shows
   `    1 │   <root section` instead of `    1 │ <root section>`); the
   `draw_menu` format string / count field needs correcting.
2. Preview title is not centered exactly like the original, and the events list
   ordering / 4-per-group limit needs verification against the original.
3. Layout engine is ad-hoc (`draw_main`); it reproduces the W=130 geometry but
   the flex shrink behaviour for narrow terminals and the calendar month-box
   clipping are only approximations.
4. `--log-name-format` default value and the config key spellings
   (`log-filename-format` vs `log-name-format`) need confirming.
5. Encryption cannot reproduce the original `.cle` bytes (key/IV derivation of
   the original is unknown), so cross-binary encrypt/decrypt will not match;
   self-consistent round trips do work.
6. Mouse events are parsed but ignored; the F1 help overlay layout is
   approximate (content placement verified, but the separator/button position
   needs checking).
7. `r` (rename) is only wired in the scratchpad view, `Delete`/`Home`/`End`/
   PageUp/PageDown keys are unhandled, and the "Make new scratchpad" entry does
   nothing (in the original it also appeared to do nothing visible).
8. No git commit/push on exit yet (validation only).

## Testing tips
* `./compile.sh` then `tmux new-session -x 130 -y 40 -s t ./executable --config <cfg>`
  and `tmux capture-pane -t t -p -e`.
* The helper scripts I used are in `/tmp/tools` (`grid.py`, `dump.py`,
  `cal.py`, `an2.py`, `ptyrun.py`, `krun.sh`).
EOF
git add -A && git -c user.name=agent -c user.email=a@b.c commit -qm "caps-log reimplementation (wip)" && git log --oneline | head -3; git status --short | head"}
